title: THE WHAT IS NEW CARD NAMES THE CONTROLLER AND 4K FIXES
why: The card was stamped v20.49 and the stamp may not trail the build by more than 0.15. Its new second line names the controller fixes (picking a save on the title, FASHION and the run tags on a pad, v20.51 and v20.58) and the 4K layout fixes (the boss bar under the messages, the HP number in its bar, the station prompts above the belt, v20.50, v20.55, v20.57); the many other bug fixes are in the change list.
now: The what is new card names the controller and 4K fixes.
